map.中餐刀工尺寸对照，选择切法查看标准尺寸(末/丁/丝/片/条)与适用菜品，规范备料: Chinese knife-cut size reference — pick a cut style to see standard sizes (slivers / dice / shreds / slices / strips) and applicable dishes, standardising prep and output.
map.按菜谱要求把食材切成「细丝」「滚刀块」等，对照标准尺寸下刀，避免大小不一导致生熟: Cut ingredients to the recipe's specification — "fine shreds", "rolling dice" — against the standard sizes to avoid uneven sizes causing uneven or raw cooking.
map.备餐摆盘或宴席拼盘时，统一切配尺寸提升出品一致性与美观度，尤其红烧、滑炒类对均匀: When plating up or building banquet platters, standardising cut size improves consistency and appearance; braised and quick-fried dishes in particular demand uniformity.
map.新手学刀工或带徒时，用尺寸对照表量化「约 0.3cm 丝、1cm 丁」，减少「少: When teaching knife skills or training apprentices, use the size reference to quantify "about 0.3 cm shreds, 1 cm dice", reducing vague terms like "a sprinkle" or "a suitable amount".
map.炒肉丝的肉丝尺寸: Size of shreds for stir-fried pork
map.：猪里脊切丝：粗丝约 0.4×0.4×4cm，细丝约 0.3×0.3×5cm；配: : pork loin shreds: coarse about 0.4×0.4×4 cm, fine about 0.3×0.3×5 cm; cut the accompanying vegetables (green and red pepper, bamboo shoots) to the same size so everything cooks together and the dish looks neat.
map.切丝和切片的长度有标准吗？: Are there standards for shred and slice length?
map.常见丝长 4–6cm、宽厚 0.2–0.4cm；片厚 0.2–0.5cm 视食材: Shreds are commonly 4–6 cm long and 0.2–0.4 cm thick; slices run 0.2–0.5 cm depending on the ingredient — thin for leafy vegetables, thicker for roots — judged by ease of eating and even cooking.
map.尺寸越接近，同温同时间成熟度越一致，避免大块夹生、小块过老；也是宴席美观与口感统: The closer the pieces are in size, the more evenly they cook at the same temperature and time, avoiding raw centres in large pieces and overcooked small ones; it is also key to banquet appearance and consistent texture.
map.滚刀块怎么切？: How do I cut rolling dice?
map.食材斜滚 45° 边切边转，每刀转约 1/4 圈，得不规则多边块，多见于土豆、萝: Cut rolling dice at a 45° slant, rotating about a quarter turn per cut, giving irregular multi-sided chunks — common in potato and radish stews, with more surface area for flavour to absorb.
